properties.name: scope
properties.value: Third-party code vendored by this component only. Meant to be merged into a product-level SBOM, not scanned on its own.

components.name: libtomcrypt
components.description: SHA-256 and mem_neq extracted into sha256.c

properties.name: source
properties.value: src/hashes/sha2/sha256.c, src/misc/mem_neq.c and the headers they need, concatenated with the preprocessor directives resolved (LTC_SHA256 and LTC_SMALL_CODE defined, LTC_CLEAN_STACK undefined)

properties.name: note
properties.value: Tracked by commit, not by version: the snapshot is taken from master past the last release tag, so a version string would match no advisory. Formatting is left as upstream so the extract stays diffable against it.
